newsitem.title: USA: Snohomish PUD invites offers for Centralia stake.
newsitem.headline: Snohomish PUD invites offers for Centralia stake.

text.p: The Snohomish County Public Utility District in Washington is inviting offers for its eight percent stake in the 1,230 megawatt (MW) Centralia coal-fired power plant, the utility confirmed Friday.
The utility said a recent study by it's staff concluded it would be more profitable to sell the Centralia stake and make more power purchases on the open market.
Snohomish said an independent power producing company has expressed interest in buying the stake, but no price negotiations have yet taken place.
Other owners of Centralia are PacifiCorp, Puget Sound Energy, Portland General Electric Co, Washington Water Power Co, Seattle City Light and Grays Harbor County Public Utility District.
